title: Payment Switch Architecture
text: Payment Switch Architecture - Payment Switch Architecture: The Payment Switch routes card, QR and account-to-account payments. Components: API gateway (30-second timeout), routing service, partner connectors (CEFTS, Visa, LankaQR, SWIFT) and a PostgreSQL transaction store with a read replica for reporting. Partner connectors use mutual TLS. Known gap (2025): partner connectors call external gateways synchronously without circuit breakers; a resilience upgrade is planned for 2026.

title: Mobile Banking Platform Architecture
text: Mobile Banking Platform Architecture - Mobile Banking Platform Architecture: The mobile app talks to a BFF (backend-for-frontend) layer, which calls the Mobile Payments API and the core banking adapter. Sessions are stored in a Redis cluster with automatic failover. Push notifications are sent through a managed notification service.

title: Enterprise Integration Architecture
text: Enterprise Integration Architecture - Enterprise Integration Architecture: Integration follows an API-first and event-driven approach: synchronous REST APIs through the API gateway for queries, and Kafka topics for state changes (payments.posted, accounts.updated). Legacy core banking is accessed only through the integration layer, never directly. All partner calls must use timeouts, retries with backoff and circuit breakers.

title: AI Assistant Reference Architecture
text: AI Assistant Reference Architecture - AI Assistant Reference Architecture: AI models are treated as external services behind an internal gateway that enforces authentication, rate limits, logging and data-loss prevention. Retrieval uses role-filtered indexes so the model never receives documents the user is not entitled to see.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02)
section: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch
text: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02) - Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch: **Date:** 2025-12-02 | **Severity:** SEV2 | **Duration:** 27 minutes **Customer impact:** approximately 10,344 failed or delayed payment transactions.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02) - Summary: An expired TLS client certificate on the Payment Switch connection to CEFTS clearing gateway caused customers to see payment failures.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02) - Timeline: - T+0: Error rate on Payment Switch rose above 5%; on-call engineer paged automatically. - T+6 min: Incident bridge opened; payments operations notified. - T+13 min: Root cause identified. - T+27 min: Service fully restored and backlog cleared.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02) - Root cause: The mutual-TLS client certificate used by Payment Switch to authenticate to CEFTS clearing gateway expired at 23:05. Certificate expiry was tracked in a spreadsheet owned by one engineer who was on leave, and no automated expiry alert existed for this endpoint.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02) - Corrective and preventive actions: 1. Renewed the certificate and restarted the connector pods. 2. Add all partner certificates to the automated expiry monitor (30/14/7-day alerts). 3. Move certificate ownership from an individual to the Platform team rota.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Payment Switch (2025-12-02) - Lessons learned: Detection worked, but prevention controls for this failure mode were missing or not enforced. Follow-up actions are tracked in the reliability backlog.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Fund Transfer Engine (2025-12-24)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Fund Transfer Engine (2025-12-24) - Root cause: Fund Transfer Engine reached its maximum of 50 database connections during the festival-season peak. A slow reconciliation query held connections for up to 40 seconds, so new payment requests queued and timed out at the API gateway after 30 seconds.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Fund Transfer Engine (2025-12-24)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Fund Transfer Engine (2025-12-24) - Corrective and preventive actions: 1. Killed the long-running reconciliation query and moved it to the read replica. 2. Raise the pool limit to 120 and add a 5-second statement timeout for OLTP paths. 3. Add an alert when pool utilisation stays above 80% for 2 minutes.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Fund Transfer Engine (2026-01-29)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Fund Transfer Engine (2026-01-29) - Root cause: CEFTS clearing gateway experienced degraded performance and responded in 20-45 seconds instead of the usual 300 ms. Fund Transfer Engine had no circuit breaker or fallback for this dependency, so worker threads blocked and the failure spread to unrelated card transactions.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Fund Transfer Engine (2026-01-29)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Fund Transfer Engine (2026-01-29) - Corrective and preventive actions: 1. Manually disabled the CEFTS clearing gateway route and queued transactions for retry. 2. Implement a circuit breaker with a 3-second timeout on all partner calls. 3. Agree an incident notification SLA with CEFTS clearing gateway.

text: Outage report: payment failures in Card Authorisation Service (2026-10-30) - Root cause: Card Authorisation Service reached its maximum of 50 database connections during the festival-season peak. A slow reconciliation query held connections for up to 40 seconds, so new payment requests queued and timed out at the API gateway after 30 seconds.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Card Authorisation Service (2026-10-30)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Card Authorisation Service (2026-10-30) - Corrective and preventive actions: 1. Killed the long-running reconciliation query and moved it to the read replica. 2. Raise the pool limit to 120 and add a 5-second statement timeout for OLTP paths. 3. Add an alert when pool utilisation stays above 80% for 2 minutes.

title: Outage report: payment failures in Card Authorisation Service (2026-10-30)
text: Outage report: payment failures in Card Authorisation Service (2026-10-30) - Lessons learned: Detection worked, but prevention controls for this failure mode were missing or not enforced. Follow-up actions are tracked in the reliability backlog.

title: Information Security Policy
text: Information Security Policy - Purpose: Protects the confidentiality, integrity and availability of Commercial Bank information.

title: Information Security Policy
text: Information Security Policy - Classification: Information is classified as **Public**, **Internal**, **Confidential** or **Restricted**. Confidential and Restricted information may only be shared with staff whose role requires it.

title: Information Security Policy
text: Information Security Policy - Access control: Access is granted on least privilege and reviewed quarterly by the line manager. Privileged access to production requires a ticket, approval from the system owner and is time-limited to 8 hours.

title: Information Security Policy
text: Information Security Policy - Passwords and secrets: Secrets must be stored in the enterprise vault. Secrets must never be placed in source code, tickets, chat messages or AI assistant prompts.

title: Acceptable Use of Generative AI Policy
section: Acceptable Use of Generative AI Policy
text: Acceptable Use of Generative AI Policy - Acceptable Use of Generative AI Policy: Staff may use approved AI assistants for internal knowledge search and drafting. Customer personal data, card numbers and credentials must never be entered into AI tools. AI-generated answers that inform a decision must be checked against the cited source. The AI assistant must not give financial advice to customers or make commitments on behalf of the bank.

title: Change Management Policy
text: Change Management Policy - Change Management Policy: All production changes require a change request, peer review and approval by the Change Advisory Board (CAB). Emergency changes may be approved by the duty manager but must be reviewed by CAB within 2 business days. **Manual changes directly in production are prohibited**; configuration must be deployed from the version-controlled pipeline. Change freeze periods apply during month-end (last 2 and first 2 business days).

title: Incident Management Policy
text: Incident Management Policy - Incident Management Policy: Severity levels: **SEV1** - customer-facing outage of a critical service; **SEV2** - partial degradation; **SEV3** - internal or minor impact. SEV1 incidents require a bridge within 15 minutes, executive notification within 30 minutes and a post-incident review within 5 business days. Customer communication for SEV1 is approved by Corporate Communications.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Remote Work Policy - Remote Work Policy: Eligible staff may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Remote access is only permitted through the bank's VPN on bank-issued devices.

title: Privileged Access Management Standard
text: Privileged Access Management Standard - Privileged Access Management Standard: Break-glass accounts for core banking are held in the vault with dual control. Use of a break-glass account triggers an alert to the CISO office and must be justified within 24 hours. This document is Restricted and available to administrators only.

title: Runbook: Payment Switch high error rate
section: Runbook: Payment Switch high error rate
text: Runbook: Payment Switch high error rate - Runbook: Payment Switch high error rate: 1. Check the Payment Switch dashboard for the failing route (card, QR, A2A). 2. Check partner gateway latency; if a partner exceeds 3 seconds, disable its route with the `route-toggle` command and queue transactions for retry. 3. Check database connection pool utilisation; above 90% indicates pool exhaustion - identify long-running queries and terminate non-OLTP sessions. 4. Check certificate expiry for partner connectors with `cert-check --all`. 5. Escalate to the payments engineering lead if not resolved within 20 minutes.

title: Runbook: Certificate renewal for partner connectors
section: Runbook: Certificate renewal for partner connectors
text: Runbook: Certificate renewal for partner connectors - Runbook: Certificate renewal for partner connectors: 1. Generate a CSR from the vault PKI engine. 2. Submit the CSR to the partner portal; obtain the signed certificate. 3. Store the certificate in the vault and update the connector secret. 4. Restart connector pods one at a time; verify a test transaction. 5. Update the certificate monitor with the new expiry date.

title: Runbook: Database connection pool exhaustion
text: Runbook: Database connection pool exhaustion - Runbook: Database connection pool exhaustion: Symptoms: API timeouts, pool utilisation above 90%. Steps: identify sessions with `pg_stat_activity` running longer than 10 seconds, terminate non-OLTP sessions, confirm reporting jobs point to the read replica, then review pool limits.

title: Runbook: Core banking end-of-day batch failure
section: Runbook: Core banking end-of-day batch failure
text: Runbook: Core banking end-of-day batch failure - Runbook: Core banking end-of-day batch failure: Re-run the failed step from the scheduler console; never re-run the full batch. Notify the finance operations team if the batch is delayed beyond 03:00.

title: Product specification: Instant Fund Transfer v2
section: Product specification: Instant Fund Transfer v2
text: Product specification: Instant Fund Transfer v2 - Product specification: Instant Fund Transfer v2: Customers can transfer up to LKR 1,000,000 per transaction instantly via CEFTS, 24/7. Daily limit LKR 2,000,000 (configurable per customer segment). Transfers above LKR 500,000 require step-up authentication. Target availability 99.95%.

title: Product specification: QR Merchant Payments
text: Product specification: QR Merchant Payments - Product specification: QR Merchant Payments: Customers pay merchants by scanning a LankaQR code in the mobile app. Merchant settlement is T+1. Maximum single payment LKR 200,000.

title: Product specification: Credit Card Virtual Cards
section: Product specification: Credit Card Virtual Cards
text: Product specification: Credit Card Virtual Cards - Product specification: Credit Card Virtual Cards: Customers can generate a virtual card number for online purchases with a configurable spending cap and expiry of 1-12 months. Virtual cards inherit the parent card's fraud rules.
